decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - The proposed roof, hip and ridge tiles should all be made of clay to match the existing, and the verges should be of a simple construction with no bargeboards

Condition : 3 - Before the re-roofing works hereby permitted are commenced, specifications for the breathable Tyvek roofing material must be submitted and approved in writing by the Council; or details of an alternative method of roof ventilation must be submitted and approved in writing by the Council; and then implemented in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 4 - Before the re-roofing works hereby permitted are commenced, a sample tile shall be removed, examined and its age determined and recorded in writing and submitted to the Council. The removal of the roof and re-roofing shall be recorded pictographically and submitted to the Council for archiving purposes.
description: Replacement of all of the roof finishes to house - (Listed Building Consent ) (Old Chiswick Conservation Area )
